annotations.title: List the small models a recipe can call

description: Lists the small models this deployment serves to recipes, by task: classify (label each row of a text column with yes/no or choice questions), extract (pull named, verbatim-grounded fields out of page or document text) and match (link the same entity across tables; planned until it is served). Returns {tasks: [{task, status, what, bindings, note?}], reference}. status is available, not_served, planned or unknown. Each binding carries its route (origin, method, path), its pinned model, max_requests_per_second, usage_today, quota, and a request_template for a per-row source: copy origin, method, path_template and model exactly, because the platform credential is chosen by that route and pin. A binding with for_recipes false is listed for completeness and never written into a recipe. The person enrols no key and pays nothing for these calls. Call it once per conversation before the brief, and offer what it lists where the table would gain from it; the build skill's references/enriching-with-small-models.md says when. Next: suggest_enrichments after a run.
